name: Iowa Native Plant Society Restore Iowa! Grants
summary: Grants for people working with youth on ecological restoration of natural areas in Iowa.

steps: Letter of intent to the INPS grant chair

geography.quote: to restore natural areas within the state of Iowa

effort.quote: Proposals include writing a letter of intent to INPS grant chair Molly McNicoll
We will respond with questions for more information, and attempt to work out details with you.

eligibility.quote: Projects must work with restoration of an Iowa native prairie remnant or oak woodland with proven good restoration potential. Prairie reconstructions will not be considered.
Projects must be completed with Iowa students or youth (high school or university students, Scout groups, etc.)
they must include some restoration-focused educational component, either in the field or in the classroom.

eligibility.rule: Restores an Iowa native prairie remnant or oak woodland, not a prairie reconstruction
Carried out with Iowa students or youth
